title: directives
description: The strategist's plan as machine-readable instructions for an executor (docs/PROTOCOL.md, Directives). Every field is optional; an executor uses its own default for anything missing.

day.description: The day the directives were written for.

wholesale_max_pct.description: Accept a wholesale lot up to this % of its estimate.

single_max_pct.description: Accept a single lot up to this % of its estimate.

stock_cap.description: gym executor: stop buying above this stock value

min_pct.description: Sell at no less than this % of the estimate.

sell_down_to_cash.description: Sell stock until cash reaches this (e.g. before rent).

sell_hot.description: gym executor: stage stolen goods for sale (default false: hold until heat 0)

services.description: Service ids to have on tonight.

upgrades_buy.description: Upgrade ids to buy tonight, in order.

scavenge.description: Go to the dumping ground tonight.

engine.description: gym executor: which production engines to run, joined by +

mortgage.description: gym executor: sign the loan shark's offer by the rule (auto), at the next offer (take), not today (later; he returns next week), never again (decline is final), or to bridge a rent the cash cannot pay

buyout_by_day.description: gym executor: answer the loan shark later while the cash buyout projects to be affordable by this day

mortgage_margin.description: gym executor: auto signs when the projected cover reaches this share of the total payments

mortgage_float.description: gym executor: cash beyond 1.5 payments that auto keeps after the down payment

mortgage_window.description: gym executor: the game days [from, to] on which auto or take may sign

mortgage_save_from_day.description: gym executor: from this day, stop buying and save toward the offer threshold

appraisal.description: gym executor: join the appraisal board and serve its clients, or not

mortgage_max_spend.description: gym executor: daily cap on trading purchases while paying the mortgage

buyout_save.description: gym executor: spending cut while saving for the cash buyout, from buyout_save_from

buyout_save_from.description: gym executor: the day buyout_save starts

fountain.description: gym executor: buy Wild's water fountain, or take the landlord's (+150 weekly rent)

bargain_buy.description: gym executor: haggling with sellers (bargain is with buyers)

speculate.description: gym executor: hold goods of these types from ordinary buyers until a market event or an Upper Levels buyer with tips, or max_days

specialty.description: gym executor: buy only goods of these types (a lot when they are lot_share of its estimate)
